package testdata

import "github.com/bplus/webframe/components/prose"

var intro = prose.Props{ID: "intro", HTML: `<h2>Intro</h2><p class="lead">Hello</p>`}

templ Help() {
	{{ s := prose.HTML("<p class=\"x\">a</p>") }}
	{{ bad := "<p class=\"x\">b</p>" }}
	@prose.Prose(prose.Props{HTML: s})
	@prose.Prose(prose.Props{HTML: prose.HTML("<table><tr><td>c</td></tr></table>")})
	<p>{ bad }</p>
}
